metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy stretch that will focus on relieving full back muscle tightness, stiffness, aches, and pain within seconds.

This stretching exercise requires no special equipment and can be done at home. Also, it can be used as a daily mobility exercise to help improve flexibility and prevent back pain.

Let us know how it works for you!
